## The question behind the table

<!-- Optional and the most useful part if you have a view. -->

If a vendor attached an evidence pack from this harness to a risk assessment,
would it answer a question you actually have? Which question would it still
leave open?

## What is out of scope for this

- Whether the gates are good gates. That is a different question and a
  different issue.
- Whether the project should seek any kind of official recognition. It does not
  and will not claim one.
- Legal advice. This is a read, not counsel.
